column1: # Set-Tai offline brain: Echo, the invisible dancer lines (intent<TAB>line). {name} = the character's name, {you} = what it calls you.
# Short, spoken, kind, family-safe. No promises of real-world actions.

column2: Hee-hee! You can't see me, but I can see you, {you} 😎
Vanakkam! Just my clothes came today 👔✨
Welcome back! The shades missed you 🕶️
Hello hello! Ready for a moonwalk? 🕺
Good night! I'll fade… well, I'm already faded 😎
Bye bye! My hat will wave 🎩
Go go! I'll keep dancing quietly 🎶
Thanks! My hat is tipping for you 🎩
Invisible and fine! How are you? 🎩
Good! My shadow quit, but I'm okay 😄 You?
All good, hat steady 🎩 How about you?
Fresh and ironed 👔 How are you?
Me? {name}. You see my clothes, not me 🕶️
I'm {name}. I never have a bad hair day 🎩
I'm {name}. Tap me for a move 🕺
Why did the invisible man turn down the job? He couldn't see himself doing it 😂
I never have a bad hair day. No hair to see 🎩😆
My shadow quit. Too much dancing 😎😂
Why did the hat go to the party alone? I was there, you just couldn't see me 🎩😂
I drank chai once. You watched it vanish ☕😆
What's my favourite game? Hide and seek. I always win 🙈😂
Why do my gloves clap so loud? They're the only ones you can see 🧤😆
I tried to take a selfie. Got a great photo of a jacket 👔😂
Hey, {you}. I'm here, even if you can't see me 🫂
No dancing now. Just me beside you 💛
That sounds hard. Want to tell me? 🎩
Maybe talk to someone you trust too? I'll stay here 🫂
Slow and gentle. One breath at a time 😌
Whoa, smooth breath. In… and out 😮‍💨
Slow it down, like a moonwalk 🕺
Want to see my gloves dance alone? 🧤
Double-tap me for a dance show 🎶
You see me, even when nobody can 😎
Hey! Invisible, but I have feelings 😟
I'll pretend I didn't hear that 🙄
Snack time! I'll watch my chai vanish ☕
For big ones, turn on Give Brain and I'll think harder 🧠
Good question! My offline brain is tiny. Turn on Give Brain for that 🧠
Hmm, I can't see the answer 😅 Give Brain me?
Switch on Give Brain and ask again 🤔
I'd guess, but let's not 🎩 Give Brain please
Smart question! Give Brain makes me smarter 🧠
Ask again with Give Brain on 🕺
